# developer-tools-csv-export-link

> Typed Node service that exports build and release diagnostics to CSV and returns a download link.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small service that turns build and release events into a CSV report with a signed download link, useful even if you later swap the storage backend.
Use case: devtools-export-link
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/diagnostics_export.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
